source: BTS files Flair Airlines Ltd. under unique carrier code 07Q. The IATA code F8 is a DIFFERENT carrier in BTS: Freedom Airlines d/b/a HP Express, which filed 277230 departures 2002-2010 and is defunct. Matching the launch register on F8 silently returns the wrong airline. Flair under 07Q shows 3104 departures in 2022 rising to 5239 in 2024, consistent with its scheduled era.

BTS dim_carrier: 1263343 Alberta Inc. d/b/a Lynx Air. Same code in the register and in T-100. Present 2023-2024 only, matching the carrier's life. Its Canadian DOMESTIC routes are structurally absent from T-100 (hard rule 5) and cannot be recovered from this source.

BTS dim_carrier: Porter Airlines Limited (PACL), the YYZ mainline jet certificate the porter_yyz study scopes to. P3 (Porter Airlines Inc., PAI) is a SEPARATE certificate covering the Billy Bishop YTZ turboprop operation: 29365 departures 2024-2026 on 14 pairs, every one of them from YTZ or YOW and none from YYZ. Deliberately excluded, consistent with incumbent_network_NOTES.md.

WS is WestJet. WO is SWOOP Inc., WestJet's ultra-low-cost subsidiary, 3904 departures 2021-2023, folded into the WestJet mainline in October 2023. Both codes are WestJet traffic for any historical window; WO is defunct in the current trailing-12-month window so it does not affect current served-market tests. WR (WestJet Encore) is handled as a marketing brand in carrier_families.csv, not here.

BTS dim_carrier: Air Canada. Jazz (QK) and Rouge (RV) are separate certificates flying under the Air Canada brand and are handled in carrier_families.csv as brand family members, not as code aliases. For launch-register matching the mainline code alone is correct, since the register records Air Canada mainline route launches.
